title: Basic Analysis - Resume Builder - Analysis Mode
description:
Welcome to our channel! In this video, we're diving deep into **Analysis Mode** of the 01-05 Resume Builder! 

Are you ready to elevate your resume to the next level? In this tutorial, we’ll walk you through the essential best practices for crafting a standout resume. Whether you're a job seeker or just looking to polish your professional image, this video is packed with valuable insights!

 **What You’ll Learn:**
- How to navigate the Analysis Mode and understand your resume score
- Essential elements your resume should include (like contact info and target title)
- The importance of a professional summary and how to create one
- Tips for addressing common resume issues and enhancing your overall presentation

 **Key Features Covered:**
- Basic functionality of the Tele Membership
- Step-by-step guidance on fixing common resume mistakes
- A sneak peek into the advanced features available with Teal Plus

Don't forget to **LIKE**, **SUBSCRIBE**, and hit that **BELL ICON**  for more tips on building an impressive resume and acing your job applications!

 **Join the Conversation:** 
Have questions or need more personalized advice? Drop a comment below, and let’s chat!

- [Teal Plus Advanced Analysis](#)

Thank you for watching, and let’s get started on making your resume shine!
